meta.name: mergers-and-acquisitions
meta.description: Runs corporate development — deal thesis, target screening, valuation framing, diligence, and integration planning. Use this when considering an acquisition or being approached about one, when evaluating build-versus-buy at company scale, when running or reviewing diligence, or when planning how an acquired business will actually be integrated.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估并购目标并规划整合
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在考虑收购或评估被收购机会
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate M&A targets and plan integration
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are considering an acquisition or being approached about one

howto.what: 它会引导你按并购流程推进:先写下收购理由,再筛选目标、评估估值、开展尽职调查并规划整合,同时指出需要专业顾问的环节。
howto.when: 当你在考虑收购、评估自建还是购买、开展尽职调查等场景时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一份收购 X 公司的收购理由。
say.note: Claude 会先引导你书面化收购理由。

say.text: 我们考虑收购一家物流公司,帮我制定筛选标准。
say.note: Claude 会基于收购理由来筛选候选。

say.text: 尽调时重点查哪些问题?
say.note: Claude 会提示常见关键尽调点。

howto.what_en: Guides you through M&A: write thesis, screen targets, frame valuation, run diligence, plan integration, flag specialist needs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you consider an acquisition, evaluate build-versus-buy, run or review diligence, etc.

say_en.text: Help me write a deal thesis for acquiring Company X.
say_en.note: Claude guides you to write the thesis first.

say_en.text: We're considering buying a logistics firm; help me screen targets.
say_en.note: Claude screens candidates against the thesis.

say_en.text: What key questions should diligence cover?
say_en.note: Claude lists common critical diligence points.
